items.question: In what mode is action accomplished after entering the bhūcarī form?
premises: The bhūcarī form is entered
Action is performed in that state
The mode of action is experiential in nature
items.inference: Entering the bhūcarī form results in action carried out as lived experience
items.plain_english: Having entered the form of the bhūcarī, action is performed in the nature of direct experience.

items.question: What process unfolds once the attainment of melāpa has been reached?
premises: The attainment of melāpa is resorted to
Devouring of time is the operative process
This devouring is extended or unfolded
items.inference: Resorting to the attainment of melāpa brings about the extension of time-devouring
items.plain_english: Having attained the union, the devouring of time is indeed extended.

items.question: Which experiential constituents are presented alongside the subtle-element impressions?
premises: Impressions in the form of subtle elements are present
The inner-organ triad is also present
Both are enumerated together
items.inference: The subtle-element impressions and the inner-organ triad are jointly identified as constituents
items.plain_english: There are the impressions in the form of the subtle elements, and likewise the triad of inner organs.

items.question: How is the śākta dimension characterized in relation to extraction of those constituents?
premises: Extraction and related operations concern those constituents
The śākta dimension is connected with these operations
This śākta dimension is eight-fold and forceful
items.inference: The śākta level is defined as an eight-fold forceful process involving extraction of those constituents
items.plain_english: Joined with their extraction and so forth, the śākta dimension is eight-fold and operates forcibly.

rows.grounds: compound: tanmātra-rūpiṇaḥ, qualifying an implied referent

items.question: By what method is the supreme state of the subtle-element-formed apprehended?
premises: A method of subtle observation is employed
The referent is formed of subtle elements
A supreme aspect is indicated
items.inference: Through subtle observation, the supreme aspect of what is formed of subtle elements is apprehended
uncertainties: The exact referent of paraṃ is implied rather than explicit
items.plain_english: By the method of subtle observation, the supreme state of that which is formed of the subtle elements is reached.

items.question: What parallel grounding is affirmed for the inner-organ triad impressions?
premises: A parallel case is indicated
The inner-organ triad has impressions
These impressions constitute a grounding
items.inference: In the same way, there is a state grounded in the impressions of the inner-organ triad
uncertainties: The subject grounded in these impressions is not explicitly named
items.plain_english: And likewise, there is that which is grounded in the impressions of the triad of inner organs.

items.question: How is the śāmbhava wheel-form established in sequential order?
premises: A wheel-form is identified as śāmbhava
That wheel is situated
Its situation follows a sequence
items.inference: The śāmbhava wheel-form is that wheel established in due sequence
items.plain_english: The śāmbhava form is a wheel, and that wheel is situated in sequence.

items.question: Why is this wheel declared to be the śāmbhava abode?
premises: The abode is identified as śāmbhava
This wheel is under discussion
A causal link is asserted by tena
items.inference: Because it is the śāmbhava abode, this wheel is declared as such
items.plain_english: Because it is the śāmbhava abode, this wheel is declared to be śāmbhava.

items.question: What transition follows after entering the raudreśī form and devouring time?
premises: The raudreśī form is entered
The devouring of time has occurred
A subsequent stage is indicated
items.inference: After entering the raudreśī form and completing time-devouring, a further stage ensues
uncertainties: The consequent action is completed in the following verse
items.plain_english: Having entered the form of Raudreśī, after the devouring of time,

items.question: How is the wheel of all impressions apprehended in the non-sequential mode?
premises: A subsequent stage is marked by tad atra
The wheel of all impressions is present
It is apprehended through a non-sequential form
items.inference: At that stage, the wheel of all impressions is apprehended in a non-sequential mode
uncertainties: The governing verb is supplied by the following verse
items.plain_english: Then here, the wheel of all impressions, in a non-sequential form,

items.question: What distinguishes the apprehension of objects according to manifest and unmanifest practice?
premises: Apprehension is distinguished by manifest and unmanifest character
This distinction arises from practice with objects
The result corresponds appropriately to each case
items.inference: Practice with objects yields an apprehension differentiated by degrees of manifestness, each in its proper way
items.plain_english: Distinguished by manifest and unmanifest character, from the practice of objects, in each case as appropriate,

rows.grounds: future passive or middle form of √ras

items.question: What scope of knowable reality will be tasted in this culminating apprehension?
premises: The object consists of sixty-four elements
The object encompasses all forms
This object will be tasted
items.inference: The culminating apprehension will taste the sixty-fourfold object in all its forms
items.plain_english: The sixty-fourfold object, comprising all forms, will be tasted.
